name: Capivara Booster v2.1.0 (Rust Edition)
notes: ## Added
- Full rewrite in Rust with Tauri v2: single lightweight executable, no .NET runtime dependency

- Low-latency engine with 11 reversible tweaks: Dynamic Tick, synthetic timers, Win32PrioritySeparation, USB selective suspend, mouse/keyboard queue sizes, mouse acceleration off, Nagle's algorithm, Delivery Optimization off, HAGS, PCIe ASPM and Power Throttling
- CS2 competitive profile: IFEO priority/affinity, AppCompat flags, Defender exclusions, shader cache cleanup and live process boost
- Valorant profile: game high priority, Riot Client low priority, Vanguard Defender exclusions and log purge
- League of Legends profile: Low Spec Mode, Close Client, VSync off with automatic config backups
- Mandatory account login: registration restricted to Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and Yahoo Brasil domains
- Live execution console with highlighted OK completion lines, hidden by default
## Security
- Local account vault encrypted with Windows DPAPI
- Passwords stored with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100k iterations), random salt and constant-time comparison
- Administrator identity kept as internal hash, never exposed
- Restrictive Content Security Policy and requireAdministrator manifest
## Changed
- Official brand identity applied: Cyber Mint / Volt Cyan palette, new logo and multi-resolution icon
## Fixed
- Auto-updater keeps the same version.json contract with SHA-256 verification, so v1.1.4 clients upgrade automatically
## PT-BR
- Reescrita completa em Rust com Tauri v2: executável único e leve, sem dependência do .NET
- Motor de baixa latência com 11 tweaks reversíveis (Dynamic Tick, MMCSS, USB, filas de mouse/teclado, Nagle, HAGS, ASPM e mais)
- Perfis competitivos para CS2, Valorant e LoL com backups e rollback
- Login obrigatório com cofre de contas protegido por DPAPI e PBKDF2
- Console ao vivo com confirmacao OK ao concluir otimizacoes
- Nova identidade visual Cyber Mint / Volt Cyan
## Added (v2.1.0)

- Driver Booster: scans all PC drivers via WMI, points to the motherboard/GPU vendor's official download page (ASUS, Gigabyte, MSI, ASRock, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and exports a full pnputil backup before any install

- Path of Exile 1 & 2 module: competitive GGG engine profile (.ini patch with backup, global illumination off, low sound channels, lockstep toggle, GPU preference, Nagle off, safe shader cache cleanup)
- Official brand icons in the sidebar (no emoji)
